args.query:
SELECT 
    e.gmap_id,
    e.name,
    e.address,
    e.num_of_reviews,
    e.avg_rating,
    e.slchd_establishment_key,
    COUNT(v.violation_id) AS total_violations,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN 1 END) AS critical_violations
FROM establishments e
JOIN inspections i ON e.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key
JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
GROUP BY e.gmap_id, e.name, e.address, e.num_of_reviews, e.avg_rating, e.slchd_establishment_key
HAVING COUNT(v.violation_id) > 0

args.query:
SELECT 
    e.name || ' (' || e.address || ')' AS restaurant,
    'Critical Violations' AS violation_type,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN 1 END) AS violation_count
FROM establishments e
JOIN inspections i ON e.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key
JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
WHERE e.slchd_establishment_key IN (
    'TEXAS ROADHOUSE|1904 W 5400 S|TAYLORSVILLE',
    'IN N OUT BURGER|3715 S CONSTITUTION BLVD|WEST VALLEY CITY',
    'CRACKER BARREL OLD COUNTRY|2283 W CITY CENTER CT|WEST VALLEY CITY',
    'IN N OUT BURGER|7206 S UNION PARK AVE|MIDVALE',
    'CHICK FIL A|1206 E 2100 S|SALT LAKE CITY'
)
GROUP BY e.name, e.address, e.num_of_reviews

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    e.name || ' (' || e.address || ')' AS restaurant,
    'Non-Critical Violations' AS violation_type,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT vc.critical THEN 1 END) AS violation_count
FROM establishments e
JOIN inspections i ON e.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key
JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
WHERE e.slchd_establishment_key IN (
    'TEXAS ROADHOUSE|1904 W 5400 S|TAYLORSVILLE',
    'IN N OUT BURGER|3715 S CONSTITUTION BLVD|WEST VALLEY CITY',
    'CRACKER BARREL OLD COUNTRY|2283 W CITY CENTER CT|WEST VALLEY CITY',
    'IN N OUT BURGER|7206 S UNION PARK AVE|MIDVALE',
    'CHICK FIL A|1206 E 2100 S|SALT LAKE CITY'
)
GROUP BY e.name, e.address, e.num_of_reviews
ORDER BY restaurant
